column1: # Ore marks for the rock faces (Terrain): drawn alone on magenta, laid over the host rock's own graded tile by the grade
# (grade.toml rows with base + overlay), so the rock under them is exactly the wall's. BLOCK_LIKE=coal_ore,iron_ore,gold_ore,banded_clay_side,red_sandstone_side,granite

column3: ore_coal_seam@-|cutout|Coal seam marks only: a horizontal seam of coal running across the FULL width of the square, a band about 10 px tall through the middle (rows 11 to 21), made of chunky black-charcoal lumps (#1e1c1c #2e2b2a #46423e) with a few small glossy grey highlights (#7a7672), its top and bottom edges ragged; it touches the left and right edges so it continues into the next block; everything above and below the seam flat solid magenta. Bold and clear, readable from far away
column4: ore_ironstone@-|cutout|Ironstone nodule marks only: 4 or 5 rounded nodules 4-7 px across scattered over the square, rusty brown-red (#5e2a18 #8a3e22 #b85a30 #d8844c), each lit on its upper left with a darker rim, not touching the edges; everything else flat solid magenta. Bold and clear, readable from far away
column5: ore_gold_quartz@-|cutout|Gold in quartz marks only: two thin pale quartz veins 1-2 px wide (#cfc9bc #e8e3d6 #f6f2ea) crossing the square at a slant, with 5-7 bright gold flecks 2-3 px (#b88018 #e8b830 #fff0a0) set along the veins, not touching the edges; everything else flat solid magenta. Bold and clear, readable from far away
column6: ore_magnetite@-|cutout|Magnetite marks only: 6 to 8 small dark crystals 2-4 px, near-black blue-grey (#202428 #363a40 #5a6068) with a tiny bright glint on each, each with a thin rusty rim (#7a3e22 #9a5430), scattered, not touching the edges; everything else flat solid magenta. Bold and clear, readable from far away

column1: # Try 2 for three of them: the first marks covered 8-20% of the tile (vanilla's ores about 50%) and vanished from 10-20 blocks away.

column3: ore_ironstone@-|cutout|Ironstone marks only, BOLD: 3 or 4 big rounded nodules 7-10 px across, dark iron-black brown (#2a1610 #3e2016 #5a2e1c) with a bright rust-orange rim and highlight on the upper left (#b85a30 #e08848), together covering about 40% of the square, not touching the edges; everything else flat solid magenta. Must stand out clearly against a red-orange sandstone from far away
column4: ore_gold_quartz@-|cutout|Gold in quartz marks only, BOLD: three thick pale quartz veins 2-3 px wide (#cfc9bc #e8e3d6 #f6f2ea) crossing the square at a slant and branching, with 6-8 big bright gold nuggets 3-5 px (#a87010 #e0b028 #fff0a0) set along them, together covering about 35% of the square, not touching the edges; everything else flat solid magenta. Must stand out clearly against pink-grey granite from far away
column5: ore_magnetite@-|cutout|Magnetite marks only, BOLD: 5 or 6 big clusters of dark crystals 5-8 px across, near-black blue-grey (#1a1e22 #2e3238 #50565e) with bright steel glints, each cluster with a rusty rim (#7a3e22 #a85c34), together covering about 40% of the square, not touching the edges; everything else flat solid magenta.
